steps.en: Install the compiler from a package manager, an archive, cargo or Docker
steps.zh: 从包管理器、压缩包、cargo 或 Docker 安装编译器
steps.code: brew install typst · cargo install --locked typst-cli

steps.en: Write the document in .typ: markup, # expressions, and set rules for layout
steps.zh: 用 .typ 写文档：标记、# 表达式，以及负责版式的 set 规则

steps.en: Parses the markup, evaluates the embedded scripting and lays the document out
steps.zh: 解析标记、求值内嵌脚本，并完成文档布局

steps.en: Compile it once, or leave a watch running while you edit
steps.zh: 编译一次，或者开着 watch 边改边看
steps.code: typst compile file.typ · typst watch file.typ

steps.en: Writes the output, rebuilding only the parts that changed
steps.zh: 写出产物，并且只重建改动过的部分

value.en: One .typ source becomes a typeset PDF — or PNG, SVG, HTML — in a single command, with no TeX installation behind it
value.zh: 一份 .typ 源在一条命令内变成排好版的 PDF——或 PNG、SVG、HTML——背后不需要装 TeX

sources: README.md Installation (brew install typst, winget install --id Typst.Typst, cargo install --locked typst-cli, nix, docker run ghcr.io/typst/typst, typst update)
